input.title: Respect quality values (q=) in locale parsing
input.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale needs to parse and respect the quality values (q= weights) in the Accept-Language header. Currently, it just picks the first supported language prefix, ignoring q values, which leads to incorrect locale selection. This change will make the API respond according to the best locale based on q values.

result.label: bug
result.evidence: The token TTL environment variable TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES is parsed as an integer of minutes only, using Number.parseInt. This means values like '12h' are not handled and instead the integer parse stops at 12, causing the token to expire after 12 minutes. The int() function in src/config.ts should validate or reject non-integer inputs to avoid misinterpreting time units.
